datasets.name: genie_cost
queryLines:
-- Portable version: derives Genie cost from system tables (no custom tables needed)
WITH -- 1) LLM token cost — direct from Genie billing
token_cost AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id, 'N/A') AS genie_space_id,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id, 'N/A') AS genie_space_name,
    CASE u.usage_metadata.genie.surface
      WHEN 'GENIE_SPACE' THEN 'Genie Agents'
      WHEN 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN 'Genie Agents'
      WHEN 'GENIE_CODE' THEN 'Genie Code'
      WHEN 'GENIE_ONE' THEN 'Genie One'
      ELSE COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'Unknown')
    END AS genie_type,
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.channel, '') AS genie_channel,
    'LLM tokens' AS cost_component,
    'billing' AS cost_source,
    u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_email,
    '' AS warehouse_id,
    0 AS statements,
    0 AS task_ms,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost_usd,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS allocated_cost_usd,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS allocated_dbu
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
-- 2) Compute cost — attribute serverless SQL warehouse cost to Genie users by query task-time share
genie_user_wh_time AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(qh.end_time) AS usage_date,
    CAST(qh.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
    qh.executed_by AS user_email,
    qh.compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
    COUNT(*) AS statements,
    SUM(qh.total_task_duration_ms) AS task_ms
  FROM
    system.query.history qh
  WHERE
    qh.end_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND qh.statement_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'MERGE', 'CREATE_TABLE_AS_SELECT')
    AND qh.compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
    AND qh.executed_by IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        identity_metadata.run_as
      FROM
        system.billing.usage
      WHERE
        billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
        AND usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
        AND identity_metadata.run_as IS NOT NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
warehouse_daily_cost AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_date,
    u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS wh_cost,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS wh_dbu
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
        )
  WHERE
    u.sku_name LIKE '%SERVERLESS%SQL%'
    AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
    AND u.usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
compute_cost AS (
  SELECT
    g.usage_date,
    g.workspace_id,
    'N/A' AS genie_space_id,
    'N/A' AS genie_space_name,
    'Genie Agents' AS genie_type,
    '' AS genie_channel,
    'Compute (SQL warehouse)' AS cost_component,
    'allocated' AS cost_source,
    g.user_email,
    g.warehouse_id,
    g.statements,
    g.task_ms,
    COALESCE(
      w.wh_cost
        * (g.task_ms / NULLIF(SUM(g.task_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY g.usage_date, g.warehouse_id), 0)),
      0
    ) AS cost_usd,
    COALESCE(
      w.wh_cost
        * (g.task_ms / NULLIF(SUM(g.task_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY g.usage_date, g.warehouse_id), 0)),
      0
    ) AS allocated_cost_usd,
    COALESCE(
      w.wh_dbu
        * (g.task_ms / NULLIF(SUM(g.task_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY g.usage_date, g.warehouse_id), 0)),
      0
    ) AS allocated_dbu
  FROM
    genie_user_wh_time g
      LEFT JOIN warehouse_daily_cost w
        ON g.usage_date = w.usage_date
        AND g.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
),
-- 3) Union both cost components
combined AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    token_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    compute_cost
)
SELECT
  usage_date,
  'production' AS environment,
  workspace_id,
  genie_space_id,
  genie_space_name,
  genie_type,
  genie_channel,
  cost_component,
  cost_source,
  user_email,
  warehouse_id,
  statements,
  task_ms,
  cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN cost_component = 'Compute (SQL warehouse)' THEN cost_usd
    ELSE 0
  END AS compute_cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN cost_component = 'LLM tokens' THEN cost_usd
    ELSE 0
  END AS token_cost_usd,
  allocated_cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN genie_type = 'Genie Agents' THEN allocated_cost_usd
    ELSE 0
  END AS agents_cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN genie_type = 'Genie Code' THEN allocated_cost_usd
    ELSE 0
  END AS code_cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN genie_type = 'Genie One' THEN allocated_cost_usd
    ELSE 0
  END AS genie_one_cost_usd,
  allocated_dbu
FROM
  combined
WHERE
  user_email IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: token_surface
queryLines:
-- Portable version: LLM token cost by surface/channel from system tables
SELECT
  'production' AS environment,
  CASE u.usage_metadata.genie.surface
    WHEN 'GENIE_SPACE' THEN 'Genie Agents'
    WHEN 'GENIE_AGENTS' THEN 'Genie Agents'
    WHEN 'GENIE_CODE' THEN 'Genie Code'
    WHEN 'GENIE_ONE' THEN 'Genie One'
    ELSE COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'Unknown')
  END AS surface,
  COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.channel, 'direct') AS channel,
  COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.agent_id, 'N/A') AS genie_space_name,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS user_email,
  u.usage_date,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) AS cost_usd
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time
      )
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY
  ALL

lines: Genie cost is now shown as **two clearly-separated components**: **Compute (SQL warehouse)** — warehouse $ attributed to Genie statements by task time (an *estimate*), and **LLM tokens (billed)** — actual pay-as-you-go token cost from `system.billing.usage` (`billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'`), split by Genie **surface**: Genie Agents, Genie Code, and Genie One. **Note:** account-wide LLM token billing began 2026-07-06, so the **token half reads $0 until usage data begins flowing** for this workspace; the compute half is populated today. Filter by environment, cost component, surface, room, compute, and user. 30-day window.
